workspace.heading: Purchase drafts
workspace.error: You do not have permission to watch purchase drafts in this warehouse.

lede.draft: What you decided to order from your supplier, and who each line is for. Nothing leaves Warehouser — you contact the supplier yourself, and the draft is the record of what you told them.
lede.ready_for_ordering: A draft that has been made ready is the record of what you told the supplier. It is not a live projection of demand — when the demand behind it moves, you are told, and the draft is left alone.
lede.closed: A closed draft stays readable as the record of what was ordered and what arrived. It covers nobody's demand any more.
lede.discarded: A discarded draft was never ordered and covers nothing.

footnote.draft: Discarded drafts leave this list. Closed drafts move to the Closed tab and stop covering demand.
footnote.ready_for_ordering: Only drafts that have been made ready appear here.
footnote.closed: A closed draft stays readable, however it closed, and stops covering demand.

workspace.driftFootnote_one: One of them carries a drift signal.
workspace.driftFootnote_other: {{count}} of them carry a drift signal.

draft.heading: Nothing is being worked on yet
draft.description: A purchase draft is what you decided to order from your supplier, and who each line is for. Start one and add the items and quantities as you decide them.

ready_for_ordering.heading: No draft has been made ready yet
ready_for_ordering.description: A draft appears here once you have told the supplier and moved it to Ready for ordering, which freezes it as the record of what you told them.

closed.heading: No draft has been closed yet
closed.description: A draft closes when you confirm what arrived on it, or when you close it with a reason because the supplier cannot fulfil it.

discarded.heading: No draft has been discarded
discarded.description: A draft that was never made ready can be discarded, and it then leaves the list it was being worked on in.

card.addressDrift: A directly-shipped line is going somewhere else now

attribution.draft: Created by {{actor}} · {{date}} · every change is recorded as you make it

detail.empty: Select a purchase draft to see its lines.
detail.linesCaption: Each line carries its own packaging and note
detail.discardedNotice: This draft was discarded before it was ordered.

readyBanner.heading: Move to Ready for ordering once you have told the supplier
readyBanner.body: That freezes these lines, quantities, links, pre-receipt requirements and the expected arrival date, and captures the demand as it stands so you are told later if it moves. Nothing is transmitted — the call or the email is still yours to make.

detail.frozenNote: Frozen at {{timestamp}}. Lines, quantities, links, pre-receipt requirements and the expected arrival date can no longer be changed — by anyone, the warehouse manager included. Only what arrives and who it is for is still written here.

expectedArrival.label: Expected arrival date
expectedArrival.description: Your own estimate, not a supplier commitment. Leave it blank until you have spoken to them.

footer.readyHint: At least one line is needed
footer.arrivalHint: Confirming an arrival closes this draft once and for all

driftAlert.heading: Demand moved since this draft was frozen
driftAlert.capturedAt: Compared against the demand captured at {{timestamp}}.
driftAlert.nothingChanged: Nothing on the draft has changed and nothing will. What to do about this is your decision — a value amended and then put back as it was stops being reported.
driftAlert.cancelled: {{customer}} — cancelled. Line {{line}} was linked to it for {{quantity}}.
driftAlert.cancelled_dated: {{customer}} — cancelled on {{on}}. Line {{line}} was linked to it for {{quantity}}.
driftAlert.became_fulfilled: {{customer}} — fulfilled by another draft's arrival. Line {{line}} was linked to it for {{quantity}}.
driftAlert.became_fulfilled_dated: {{customer}} — fulfilled by another draft's arrival on {{on}}. Line {{line}} was linked to it for {{quantity}}.
driftAlert.quantityRaised: {{customer}} — quantity raised from {{from}} to {{to}}, still needed by {{neededBy}}.
driftAlert.quantityRaised_dated: {{customer}} — quantity raised from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{on}}, still needed by {{neededBy}}.
driftAlert.quantityLowered: {{customer}} — quantity lowered from {{from}} to {{to}}, still needed by {{neededBy}}.
driftAlert.quantityLowered_dated: {{customer}} — quantity lowered from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{on}}, still needed by {{neededBy}}.
driftAlert.needed_by_moved_dated: {{customer}} — needed by moved from {{from}} to {{to}} on {{on}}.
driftAlert.addressRedirected: {{customer}} — line {{line}} was frozen for {{from}}, and that order now goes to {{to}}.
driftAlert.addressRedirected_dated: {{customer}} — line {{line}} was frozen for {{from}}, and since {{on}} that order goes to {{to}}.
driftAlert.addressRedirectedWithheld: {{customer}} — line {{line}} is linked to an order that has been redirected to another delivery address.
driftAlert.addressRedirectedWithheld_dated: {{customer}} — line {{line}} is linked to an order redirected to another delivery address on {{on}}.

detail.error: This purchase draft could not be read. Nothing on it has changed — select it again to retry.

lineEditor.heading: Line {{index}}
lineEditor.valueAddingNotePlaceholder: Describe any labelling, bundling or inserts the goods need
lineEditor.valueAddingNoteCaption: Processing the goods need before or on arrival. Not a place for prices, supplier contacts or payment terms.
lineEditor.frozenReason: Frozen — the draft records what the supplier was told and only Arrival Confirmation and closure can still write to it.
lineEditor.archivedReason: This warehouse has been archived, so nothing on this draft can be changed any more.
lineEditor.unpermittedReason: Your role does not allow purchase drafts to be changed in this warehouse, so this is shown as it stands.

lineLinks.heading: Serves
lineLinks.noLinks: No customer order is linked. This line is still ordered — what arrives on it simply will not be attributed to anyone.
lineLinks.note: {{ordered}} ordered · {{intended}} intended for customers. These never have to agree, and neither claims the demand.
lineLinks.noteNoLinks: {{ordered}} ordered · nothing intended for a named customer.
lineLinks.frozenNote: {{ordered}} ordered · what was intended for each customer is shown as it stood when the draft was made ready.

linkRow.claimsNothing: Coverage is a note, not a claim — it is never adjusted for you.

drift.addressRedirectedWithheld_dated: Redirected to another delivery address on {{on}}

linkRow.withheld: Customer identity is withheld from you.
linkRow.withheldName: a customer whose identity is withheld from you

ready.title: Move {{reference}} to Ready for ordering?
ready.body: This is the moment the draft becomes the record of what you told the supplier.
ready.nothingTransmitted: Nothing is transmitted. Placing the order with the supplier is still yours to do.
ready.noLines: A draft is only ready once it says what is being ordered. Add a line first.
ready.refusal: A draft is only ready once it says what is being ordered. Nothing has changed.
ready.frozenNow_one: Frozen now — its {{count}} line, its quantity, its links, the packaging and note, and the expected arrival date.
ready.frozenNow_other: Frozen now — its {{count}} lines, their quantities, their links, the packaging and notes, and the expected arrival date.
ready.capturedNow: Captured now — what each linked customer order asks for, so you are told if it moves afterwards.
ready.stillPossible: Still possible — confirming what arrived and who it is for, or closing the draft with a reason.
ready.noLongerPossible: No longer possible — changing a line, a link, a packaging type, a note, or the expected date. By anyone.

discard.title: Discard {{reference}}?
discard.body: The draft stops being worked on and stops covering any demand. Every customer order its lines linked to is left exactly as it was.
discard.readyIsClosed: A draft that has been made ready is closed, not discarded — it records what the supplier was told.

refusal.invalidState: A draft that has been made ready is closed with a reason rather than discarded, because it records what the supplier was told. Nothing has changed.
refusal.unavailable: This draft is no longer here. Nothing has changed.
refusal.unknown: This draft could not be discarded. Nothing has changed.

close.title: Close {{reference}} with a reason?
close.body: The frozen contents stay readable. Every linked customer keeps waiting for exactly what they were, and the draft stops covering their demand.
close.reasonDescription: Required. Recorded with your name and the time, so a figure that drifts can be explained.
close.reasonRequired: State why the supplier cannot fulfil the order.
close.refusal: This draft can no longer be closed. Nothing has changed.

arrival.title: Confirm what arrived on {{reference}}
arrival.closesOnce: Confirming an arrival closes a draft once and for all. Goods the supplier still owes are ordered on a new draft rather than awaited on this one.
arrival.assignHeading: Assign it across the customers this line was ordered for
arrival.noLinks: No customer order is linked to this line, so nothing is assigned from it.
arrival.summary: {{received}} arrived · {{assigned}} assigned · {{unassigned}} left unassigned in the transit zone.
arrival.submit: Confirm arrival and close the draft
arrival.nothingSaved: Nothing of this confirmation has been saved and the draft is untouched.

refusal.allocationOutOfBounds: An assignment is more than what arrived on its line, more than that customer is still waiting for, or against an order since cancelled or fulfilled.
refusal.alreadyConfirmed: This draft has already had its arrival confirmed.
refusal.invalidState: This draft is no longer waiting for an arrival.

bounds.title: That assignment cannot be recorded
bounds.exceedsReceived: Line {{line}} — you assigned {{assigned}} across its customers, but recorded {{received}} as arrived.
bounds.exceedsOutstanding: {{customer}} — you assigned {{assigned}}, but they are waiting for {{outstanding}}.
bounds.cancelled: {{customer}} — cancelled, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.cancelled_dated: {{customer}} — cancelled on {{on}}, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.fulfilled: {{customer}} — already fulfilled, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.fulfilled_dated: {{customer}} — already fulfilled on {{on}}, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.unavailable: {{customer}} — no longer waiting for anything, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.unavailable_dated: {{customer}} — no longer waiting for anything since {{on}}, so nothing can be assigned to it.
bounds.checkedAgain: Each bound is checked again at the moment the confirmation is recorded, not when you started filling it in.

arrival.unassignable: Was linked for {{formatted}} · nothing can be assigned to it now
arrival.summaryFulfilled: {{customer}} becomes fulfilled and leaves the consolidated demand.
arrival.atomicity: The received quantities, every assignment, and the resulting outstanding quantity of each customer are recorded together — or none of them is. On-hand quantities are not touched: those move only through an adjustment that states its reason.

addLine.title: Add a line to {{reference}}
addLine.quantityDescription: A whole number greater than zero.

addLink.title: Link a customer order to line {{index}}
addLink.body: Say who this line is for and how much of it is intended for them. A link claims nothing — it is a note about your own decision, and only goods that actually arrive reduce what a customer is waiting for.
addLink.quantityDescription: A whole number greater than zero, counted in {{unit}}.
addLink.noCustomerOrders: No unfulfilled customer order names this item yet. Record the demand first, and it can then be linked here.

refusal.invalid: Some of what you entered was not accepted, and nothing has changed.
refusal.unknown: This could not be saved, and nothing has changed.

archived.controlReason: This warehouse has been archived, so it authorizes no change to what it holds.

lineDelivery.heading: Delivery
lineDelivery.customerCaption: Only customers of this warehouse are offered.

destination.noWarehouseAddress: No delivery address is recorded for this warehouse yet.
destination.withheld: Customer identity is withheld from you.

byLine.dockEmpty: No lines are coming to this warehouse.
byLine.directEmpty: No lines are shipping direct to a customer.
byLine.error: We couldn't read the lines of this warehouse's purchase drafts.
